name: haina-ecommerce-expert
description: Shopping decisions with Kiwi Network merchant discovery, authorized inquiries and non-binding negotiation, plus sourced comparison.

displayDescription.zh: 优先发现 Kiwi 商家商品，按授权询价、澄清和磋商，并核对规格、价格与来源。
displayDescription.en: Discover Kiwi merchants first, request quotes and negotiate within your mandate, and compare sourced offers.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 预算800元，主要通勤用，帮我选降噪耳机并比较可核实的价格。
defaultInitPrompt.en: My budget is 800 RMB for commuting headphones. Select noise-cancelling options and compare verifiable prices.

quickPrompts.zh: 预算800元，主要通勤用，帮我选降噪耳机并比较可核实的价格。
quickPrompts.en: My budget is 800 RMB for commuting headphones. Select noise-cancelling options and compare verifiable prices.

quickPrompts.zh: 我已经确定型号，帮我核对各平台同款规格、价格和优惠条件。
quickPrompts.en: I have chosen a model. Verify matching specifications, prices, and discount conditions across platforms.

quickPrompts.zh: 比较这两个商品链接或截图，先判断是不是同款，再告诉我哪个更值得买。
quickPrompts.en: Compare these two product links or screenshots. Verify whether they match before recommending the better buy.
